mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loan_acceleration WHERE loan_account_id = #{loanAccountId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loan_acceleration (loan_account_id, converted_date, applied_base_rate, applied_additional_rate, carried_interest, carried_overdue_principal, carried_delinquency_charge) VALUES (#{loanAccountId}, #{convertedDate}, #{carryOver.appliedBaseRate}, #{carryOver.appliedAdditionalRate}, #{carryOver.carriedInterest}, #{carryOver.carriedOverduePrincipal}, #{carryOver.carriedDelinquencyCharge})
mapper.select: SELECT a.converted_date, a.applied_base_rate, a.applied_additional_rate, a.carried_interest, a.paid_carried_interest, a.carried_overdue_principal, a.paid_carried_overdue_principal, a.carried_delinquency_charge, a.paid_carried_delinquency_charge, adc.charge_date, adc.delinquency_target_amount, adc.delinquency_rate, adc.delinquency_charge, adc.paid_delinquency_charge, adc.interest_amount, adc.paid_interest, adc.delinquency_status_id FROM loan_acceleration a LEFT JOIN acceleration_daily_charge adc ON adc.loan_acceleration_id = a.loan_acceleration_id WHERE a.loan_account_id = #{loanAccountId} ORDER BY adc.charge_date
